analysis.headline: USD/KRW drops 3.5 KRW to 1,342.4 as KOSPI reclaims 5,006; NDF eases to 1,340.0
analysis.summary: USD/KRW fell 3.5 KRW to 1,342.4 in Seoul (ECB 1,344.5) as KOSPI jumped 6.32% to 5,006.03 on Nvidia CEO news, drawing foreign inflows and exporter sales. Overnight Nasdaq (-1.48%) cooled while DXY dipped to 103.8, guiding 1M NDF down to ~1,340.0.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW slips to 1,474.0 as won gains outweigh 7th monthly rise in German Ifo
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW eased to around 1,474.0 (ECB ref 1,473.99). Germany's Nov Ifo Business Climate rose for a 7th straight month to 90.6 and DXY softened to 103.8, lifting EUR/USD to 1.096–1.097, yet Seoul's firmer won at 1,342.4 outweighed euro gains.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW falls to 845.2 per 100 JPY as won strengthens and yen hovers near 159.2
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW moved down to around 845.2 per 100 JPY (ECB ref 8.452). As Tokyo reopened, USD/JPY stayed rangebound near 159.2 amid FinMin Katayama's verbal intervention warnings and BoJ hike watch, while Seoul's won gain to 1,342.4 lowered the cross.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW dips to 1,761.0 as won rally offsets sterling rebound above 1.310
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW eased to around 1,761.0 (ECB ref 1,761.04). Despite BoE Chief Economist Pill stressing price stability, softer DXY momentum helped GBP/USD recover back above 1.310, though Seoul's won advance to 1,342.4 dragged the cross lower.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW eases to 201.7 on won rebound and slightly firmer 6.7111 PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW slipped to around 201.7 (ECB ref 201.74). Although the PBOC nudged its USD/CNY midpoint firmer to 6.7111 from 6.7120 and offshore yuan held steady near 6.661–6.666, Seoul's 3.5 KRW drop in USD/KRW to 1,342.4 pulled the cross lower.

AUD.headline: AUD edges up to 892.9 KRW as softer dollar lifts AUD/USD toward 0.664 ahead of CPI
AUD.brief: AUD edged up to 892.9 KRW as a softer USD lifted AUD/USD toward 0.664 ahead of Australian CPI, outweighing won strength.

CAD.headline: CAD slips to 938.4 KRW on won gain despite hawkish BoC offsetting $80 WTI crude
CAD.brief: CAD eased to 938.4 KRW as Seoul's won gain outweighed BoC Governor Macklem's hawkish tone pulling USD/CAD under 1.430 amid ~$80 WTI.

CHF.headline: CHF dips to 1,605.1 KRW with EUR/CHF near 0.916–0.918 and firmer Korean won
CHF.brief: Swiss franc eased to 1,605.1 KRW as EUR/CHF held near 0.916–0.918 amid US–Iran talks and tech cooling while USD/KRW fell to 1,342.4.

CNY.headline: CNY eases to 201.7 KRW on Seoul won strength despite firmer 6.7111 PBOC midpoint
CNY.brief: Yuan eased to 201.7 KRW after Seoul's 3.5 KRW drop in USD/KRW to 1,342.4 outweighed a firmer 6.7111 PBOC fix and steady 6.66 CNH.

EUR.headline: EUR slips to 1,474.0 KRW on won rally despite 7th straight gain in German Ifo
EUR.brief: Euro eased to 1,474.0 KRW as Seoul won strength (1,342.4) offset EUR/USD's recovery to 1.096–1.097 on Germany's rising Ifo (90.6).

GBP.headline: GBP eases to 1,761.0 KRW as won gain outweighs sterling recovery above 1.310
GBP.brief: Sterling dipped to 1,761.0 KRW; a softer DXY lifted GBP/USD back over 1.310 amid Pill's price remarks, yet won gains dragged the cross.

HKD.headline: HKD eases to 171.5 KRW tracking USD/KRW drop to 1,342.4 under 7.842 USD peg
HKD.brief: Hong Kong dollar stayed pegged near 7.842 and fell to 171.5 KRW in lockstep with Seoul's 3.5 KRW decline in USD/KRW to 1,342.4.

JPY.headline: JPY drops to 845.2 KRW per 100 JPY as yen holds near 159.2 on intervention watch
JPY.brief: With Tokyo back open, USD/JPY held near 159.2 amid FinMin Katayama's warnings while won strength (1,342.4) lowered JPY/KRW to 845.2.

KRW.headline: KRW strengthens to 1,342.4 as KOSPI jumps 6.3% to 5,006; NDF eases to 1,340.0
KRW.brief: Won rose 3.5 KRW to 1,342.4 as KOSPI surged 6.32% to 5,006.03 on foreign net-buying; softer DXY pulled overnight 1M NDF to ~1,340.0.

USD.headline: DXY eases to 103.8 as Nasdaq dips 1.5% and 10Y yield holds 4.91%; Seoul 1,342.4
USD.brief: While Dow rose 0.85%, Nasdaq (-1.48%) cooled and 10Y yields eased near 4.91%, nudging DXY to 103.8 and USD/KRW to 1,342.4 (ECB 1,344.5).
